plainSummary: Evidence and approvals become stale when source changes, while declared output and metadata updates preserve unchanged evidence.
summary: Independent fingerprint.break.test.ts has seven passing tests for stale closed-turn waiver/approval reuse, code-review source binding with declared-output exclusions, idempotent external receipts and stale/traversal denial, missing legacy fingerprints and changed source/untracked/same-ID checks, content-preserving commits/metadata, command-time source mutation, and required artifact tamper/missing/symlink escape. All three owned breaker suites rerun together: node --test packages/ledger/dist/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.js packages/ledger/dist/verify/aggregation.break.test.js packages/ledger/dist/verify/readonly.break.test.js; 13 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Owned older fixtures now explicitly execute checkLedger before fetching historical report, stamp external evidence, and place the read-side-effect sentinel in ledger metadata; original ordering and no-read-write assertions remain intact. Production exclusion inconsistency surfaced during review was corrected before final run. writeReview stamps the current content digest.
killersCited: packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::does not let a closed turn reuse its old waiver or approval after source changes
packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::binds code review to source content while excluding declared evidence outputs
packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::records current external evidence idempotently and refuses stale or escaping submissions
packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::rejects legacy evidence and evidence replayed after source or same-ID check changes
packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::retains evidence across ledger metadata and content-preserving commits
packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::invalidates results if a successful command changes its own source inputs
packages/ledger/src/evidence/fingerprint.break.test.ts::checks required artifacts even when their declared output path is excluded from source hashing
residualRisks: Fingerprint correspondence does not authenticate producers or prove behavioral coverage; trusted local caller boundary remains explicit.
No concurrent-writer stress test was run; evidence receipt retry and conflicting run IDs are covered sequentially.
Required remote artifacts remain unverified without observable local bytes; this review makes no remote artifact availability claim.
Permission, deferral, and visible session completion behavior are later slices; this approval covers source/check/artifact freshness and scoped approval invalidation only.
